title: Staging drain task not joined on shutdown
description: Transit main.rs spawns the staging drain task (line 765) with no retained JoinHandle. On shutdown, ingestion_handle is awaited but the staging task runs detached. Clean-exit path (main returns): Tokio runtime drops and the staging task future is cancelled mid-pipeline with exit code 0. Timeout path: process::exit(1) fires without waiting for staging. In either case staged articles mid-pipeline are silently lost. The RUNBOOK Graceful shutdown section does not mention staging at all.
